title: xxxHOLiC
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kimihiro Watanuki, a high schooler plagued by spirits, stumbles into a shop run by the witch Yuko Ichihara, who grants wishes for a fair price (to verify). To pay for his wish to stop seeing spirits he works for her as cook and errand boy, meeting cursed customers, youkai and his classmates Doumeki and Himawari in episodic tales that cross over with CLAMP's Tsubasa (to verify).
life_message: It holds up the idea that everything has its price and that a person's life matters to those around them, so self-sacrifice is not the whole answer (to verify).

content.note: Occasional injuries from spirits and curses, including to Watanuki's eye (to verify).
Ghost stories, curses and a melancholy turn in later volumes (to verify; AniList Ghost, Curses tags).
Watanuki's crush on Himawari; Yuko's revealing outfits (to verify; MangaDex safe).
Comedic yelling between Watanuki and Doumeki (to verify).
Yuko drinks sake heavily and smokes a pipe, shown as part of her character; later Watanuki too (to verify).
Watanuki's disregard for his own life is a recurring theme others push back on (to verify).
Rituals, charms and divination shown as effective (to verify).
Part of CLAMP's crossover franchise with anime and live-action adaptations (to verify).

dominant: Pagan/occult (witchcraft, youkai), Dharmic (karma-like price, fate), Existentialism
